decisions.notes: DURATION_MISMATCH: duration_days=1825 (five years) correctly reflects the ORIGINAL proposed term from the 2026-05-12 interim-urgency-moratorium proposal, which (per the row's own account) was never brought back for adoption; the city instead pivoted to pursuing a permanent (indefinite) prohibition that also has not been adopted. Per process guidance, since the '5-year' figure is an earlier, abandoned proposal rather than an adopted term, the typed value is left unchanged. Checked all five Calipatria City Council agendas posted between the July 14, 2026 preliminary vote and the 2026-09-23 research date (Jul 28, Aug 11, Aug 25, Sept 8, Sept 22); none contain a data-center prohibition ordinance as an action item, confirming the row's account that the drafted permanent ban has not returned to Council for a final vote. This also refutes a third-party aggregator (aigridwatch.com) claim of 'final adoption Aug 26' for a Calipatria data-center ban, which is not supported by the city's own posted agendas.
